note: A3 ready-made encounters (F-R7, F-R10; Kieran's approval K210, lore R96). Edit here; build/build_terrain.py checks every name against the monsters pack and writes arneyan/module/data/terrains.mjs.

twists.name: Undergrowth
twists.text: thick brush off the path is difficult terrain for both sides; the open path is the obvious killing ground.

twists.name: Rotten giant
twists.text: a dead tree leans over the fight; a heavy blow or a loud spell brings it down across one area.

twists.name: Dry wood
twists.text: a stray spark catches, and the fire spreads a few squares a round downwind.

twists.name: Captive
twists.text: the foes hold a woodcutter, a child or a trussed deer they're about to butcher.

twists.name: Fallen trunk
twists.text: a ridge of roots and trunk gives height and cover to whoever takes it.

twists.name: Drawn by the noise
twists.text: in round 2 a hungry beast from this terrain's table arrives, hostile to both sides.

1-4.nonfight: Woodcutters at a charcoal burner's camp share news of what's been seen nearby.

5-8.nonfight: A hermit warns the party off the old road: something has been taking his goats.

9-12.nonfight: A hunter's cache in a hollow oak: a few days' rations and a small treasure (GM's choice).

13+.nonfight: Druids holding a moot in a grove ask the party to leave the wood as they found it.

twists.name: Scree
twists.text: loose stone on the slope; anyone knocked down slides a couple of squares downhill.

twists.name: Barrow mouth
twists.text: an open barrow offers shelter and grave goods, and something inside wakes if either side goes in.

twists.name: Valley fog
twists.text: beyond a few squares, everything is hidden.

twists.name: Stampede
twists.text: in round 2 a frightened flock or herd pours through the fight.

twists.name: Signal fire
twists.text: the foes try to light a beacon that will bring more of them.

twists.name: Hilltop
twists.text: height and a ring of stones for cover.

1-4.nonfight: Shepherds driving their flock: they've lost two sheep to something in the next valley.

5-8.nonfight: An old barrow on a hilltop, its door stone rolled aside: explore it or move on.

5-8.label: An ogre mage and its ogres
A hill giant and its ogres

9-12.nonfight: A hill fort's beacon is lit; riders ask whether the party has seen raiders.

13+.nonfight: A giant's boundary stone, carved with warnings in Giant.

13+.label: A smiling one and an ettin

twists.name: Narrow ledge
twists.text: one side of the path drops away; a push or a fall there is a long one.

twists.name: Loose rock above
twists.text: a loud spell or a heavy blow starts a rockslide on one area.

twists.name: Gale
twists.text: gusts sweep the ledge each round; flyers and anyone at the edge are at risk of being blown about.

twists.name: Rope bridge
twists.text: the fight starts at a bridge over a gorge, and either side can cut it.

twists.name: Cave mouth
twists.text: a shelter one side can hold.

twists.name: Snowfield
twists.text: a crust over hidden drops, weaker every round it takes weight.

1-4.nonfight: Rockfall ahead: the pass is blocked for a day unless the party climbs round it.

5-8.nonfight: A road shrine with fresh offerings; travellers' marks show the safe path.

5-8.label: An annis hag and her ogre

9-12.nonfight: An avalanche on the next slope: the party loses half a day going round.

9-12.label: A frost giant and its wolves

13+.nonfight: Storm clouds sit on the peak; lightning pins the party down for a day.

13+.label: A behir and a stone giant

twists.name: Tall grass
twists.text: cover for anyone who crouches, and it burns fast.

twists.name: Stampede
twists.text: in round 2 a herd thunders through the fight.

twists.name: Runners
twists.text: one or two foes try to break away and warn the rest of their band.

twists.name: Old watchtower
twists.text: a ruined stump of a tower gives height and cover.

twists.name: Storm
twists.text: heavy rain arrives in round 2, putting out fires and hiding anything at range.

twists.name: Caravan
twists.text: the foes are after a trader's wagons and the people in them.

1-4.nonfight: A herd of elk a mile wide crosses the trail; it has passed by noon.

5-8.nonfight: A trade caravan shares its fire and sells supplies at town prices.

9-12.nonfight: Smoke on the horizon: a burnt farmstead, its folk fled to the nearest town.

13+.nonfight: A rider with a royal writ asks the party to carry word to the nearest lord.

13+.label: A rune giant and its hill giants

twists.name: Sucking mud
twists.text: difficult terrain that drags at anyone who stands still in it, worse each round.

twists.name: Swamp gas
twists.text: pockets of gas burst into flame at the first fire spell or torch.

twists.name: Channels
twists.text: deep water cuts the field; swim, or find the log bridges.

twists.name: Fog
twists.text: beyond a few squares, everything is hidden.

twists.name: Stilt hut
twists.text: a captive is held in a hut on stilts above the water.

twists.name: Something below
twists.text: something in the deep water grabs whoever stays in it longest.

1-4.nonfight: Lights dance over the water at dusk; anyone who follows them is lost for an hour.

5-8.nonfight: A stilt village of fisherfolk trades smoked eel and news.

5-8.label: A green hag and her bullywugs

9-12.nonfight: A drowned temple's roof breaks the water; its bell rings when no one is near.

13+.nonfight: Fog rolls in; the party can't find its way out until it lifts a day later.

twists.name: Dunes
twists.text: height on the crest, and sand that slides under anyone fighting on the slope.

twists.name: Sandstorm
twists.text: it rolls in during round 2 and scatters the fight.

twists.name: Sinking sand
twists.text: a patch of quicksand that holds whoever steps in until pulled out.

twists.name: The water
twists.text: both sides want the waterskins, or the only well for a day's ride.

twists.name: Buried ruin
twists.text: the fight is on a half-buried roof with a pit beneath.

twists.name: Mirage
twists.text: some of the foes the party sees aren't there.

1-4.nonfight: An oasis with sweet water and shade; camel tracks lead away from it.

5-8.nonfight: A sandstorm: the party shelters for the day and makes no progress.

9-12.nonfight: A half-buried statue points the way to a lost city.

13+.nonfight: A city shimmers on the horizon and is gone at dusk.

twists.name: Lake ice
twists.text: the fight is on a frozen lake that cracks a little more each round.

twists.name: Whiteout
twists.text: driving snow hides everything beyond a few squares.

twists.name: Avalanche slope
twists.text: a loud spell or a heavy blow brings snow down on one area.

twists.name: Ice cave
twists.text: a shelter one side can hold out of the wind.

twists.name: Frozen traveller
twists.text: someone half-frozen in the snow will die if the fight runs long.

twists.name: The camp fire
twists.text: whoever holds the fire holds the warmth, and the foes want it too.

1-4.nonfight: A blizzard: the party digs in for the day.

1-4.label: A winter wolf and its pack

5-8.nonfight: A cairn holding a frozen explorer, with his journal and a map.

5-8.label: A bheur hag and her wolf

9-12.nonfight: The aurora burns all night; the party's animals won't move till dawn.

9-12.label: A frost giant and its wolves

13+.nonfight: Cracking ice: the party loses a day going round open water.

13+.label: An everlasting one and its trolls

twists.name: Tide
twists.text: the beach shrinks every round until the sea meets the cliff.

twists.name: Wet rocks
twists.text: slippery boulders with drops into the surf.

twists.name: Wreck
twists.text: a beached hull to climb, and a hold worth searching.

twists.name: Fog bank
twists.text: beyond a few squares, everything is hidden.

twists.name: Smugglers' cave
twists.text: barrels and crates to hide behind, open, or roll.

twists.name: Storm surge
twists.text: every other round a big wave sweeps the low ground.

1-4.nonfight: Wreckage on the tide line: a barrel of salt pork and a coil of good rope.

1-4.label: A sea hag and her merrow

5-8.nonfight: A lighthouse keeper begs for news and offers a dry floor for the night.

9-12.nonfight: A ship's boat with three survivors, who want passage to the nearest port.

13+.nonfight: A storm drives the party off the cliff path; they shelter in caves for a day.

twists.name: Darkness
twists.text: light is what you bring, and anyone carrying it is a target.

twists.name: Cracked roof
twists.text: a loud spell or a heavy blow brings part of the roof down.

twists.name: Chasm
twists.text: a narrow stone bridge over a drop.

twists.name: Rising water
twists.text: an underground river is breaking through, and the tunnel floods round by round.

twists.name: Spore caps
twists.text: giant fungi burst when struck, with clouds that blind or choke both sides.

twists.name: Two tunnels
twists.text: the foes come from both ends.

1-4.nonfight: A deep gnome trading party sells mushrooms and a map of the next few miles.

5-8.nonfight: A glowing fungus forest with enough edible mushrooms for a week's rations.

5-8.label: A mind flayer and its thralls

9-12.nonfight: An underground river; a ferryman poles a raft and asks a silver piece a head.

13+.nonfight: A cavern of humming crystals; spells feel strange here, but nothing more.

13+.label: A neothelid and its mind flayers
Elder brain or a drow matron

twists.name: Barn and haystacks
twists.text: cover that burns.

twists.name: Bystanders
twists.text: farmhands or travellers are caught in the middle.

twists.name: The cart
twists.text: the foes want what's in a cart, and the horse panics.

twists.name: Hedgerows
twists.text: thick hedges between fields are cover and difficult terrain.

twists.name: Night
twists.text: the fight is lit only by lanterns and a burning thatch.

twists.name: Militia
twists.text: the village turns out in round 3, eager and unpredictable.

1-4.nonfight: A pedlar with a mule, selling trinkets and gossip.

5-8.nonfight: A village fair; a day here brings news of the whole region.

5-8.label: An ogre mage and its ogres
A lord's men demand a toll (they can be talked down)

9-12.nonfight: A coaching inn with hot food, a bath and a guide for hire for the next stretch.

9-12.label: Vampire on the road at night

13+.nonfight: A royal progress blocks the road for half a day; heralds clear the way.

13+.label: A smiling one and an ettin

twists.name: Undergrowth and vines
twists.text: difficult terrain and concealment off the trail.

twists.name: River
twists.text: a fast river full of quippers cuts the field.

twists.name: Rope bridge
twists.text: the fight starts at a bridge over a gorge, and either side can cut it.

twists.name: Ruined temple
twists.text: old traps still work, for whoever finds the levers.

twists.name: Downpour
twists.text: a monsoon burst hides everything at range.

twists.name: Swarm
twists.text: disturbed insects swarm over both sides in round 2.

1-4.nonfight: Ruins of a stepped pyramid, half swallowed by vines; nothing stirs.

5-8.nonfight: A rope bridge over a gorge, frayed but holding.

9-12.nonfight: A cloud of bright butterflies settles on the party: harmless, and said to be lucky.

13+.nonfight: Jungle folk guarding a sacred tree; they mean no harm if the party passes by.

13+.label: A nalfeshnee in a ruined temple

twists.name: Rolling deck
twists.text: anyone at the rail risks going over the side.

twists.name: Rigging
twists.text: height for whoever climbs.

twists.name: Fire aboard
twists.text: a lantern or a spell sets the ship alight.

twists.name: Holed
twists.text: the hull is breached, and the ship takes water every round.

twists.name: Fog
twists.text: beyond a few squares, everything is hidden.

twists.name: A sail
twists.text: another ship closes in during round 3, friend or foe.

1-4.nonfight: Dolphins run with the ship for an hour; sailors call it a good omen.

1-4.label: A sea hag and her merrow

5-8.nonfight: Becalmed: the ship drifts all day and makes no headway.

9-12.nonfight: A ghost ship drifts past in the fog and is gone.

13+.nonfight: A waterspout: the ship loses a day sailing round it.

wayThrough.text: Hungry, scared or guarding young. Food thrown down, fire, or backing out of their ground ends it; a badly hurt pack breaks (Morale).
They want something: a toll, loot, a captive, revenge. Talk, a bribe, a bluff or a show of strength can end it; if the leader falls, the rest test Morale.
Territorial or hunting. Leave its ground, give it easier prey, or hurt it badly enough and it flees (Morale).
Bound to a place or a wrong. Leave their ground before dark, hold them off with daylight or holy symbols, or lay them to rest by righting the wrong.
Proud and greedy. Tribute, flattery, a riddle or a useful bargain; few fight to the death when a deal will do.
Raiders and hunters. A toll in food or coin, a contest of strength or wits, or showing that the party is poor prey.

wayThrough.kind: Fiends, fey, aberrations, elementals and celestials
wayThrough.text: Bound by a summoning, a pact or old rules. Learn the binding and use it: a true name, a gift, a bargain, the circle that holds them.
Mindless. Go round, burn a path, or lure them away.
